recommendation: Keep the core audit commit as-is. Any future ShareablePlanDefinition profile maintenance should be done in CRMI/source package work rather than by restoring the retired base-spec profile.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive STU3 issue asking FHIR core PlanDefinition to define a ShareablePlanDefinition profile analogous to ShareableValueSet, requiring url, version, name, title, experimental, description, date, and publisher.
initial_application: The issue was applied by git commit 7fab0975b9f824870fcc1ca9f28322401123675a, which added source/plandefinition/plandefinition-shareable-spreadsheet.xml and updated source/plandefinition/plandefinition-spreadsheet.xml. R5 history still contains the profile metadata.
additional_context: Later Applied/Persuasive R6 issue FHIR-48393 removed ShareablePlanDefinition and related shareable/publishable resource profiles from the base specification because they had already moved to CRMI. Current core source retains PlanDefinition and the Shareable pattern guidance, points users to CRMI for Shareable/Publishable profiles, and has no active ShareablePlanDefinition source/reference beyond historical release data and the OID entry.
reconciliation: Published an empty external-repo audit commit on the combined branch. No source edit was made because reintroducing the removed core profile would conflict with the later R6 migration/removal decision.

related_jiras.note: Applied R6 decision removed ShareablePlanDefinition and related resource profiles from core because they had already moved to CRMI.
Later Published issue maintained the same ShareablePlanDefinition profile in R5 before FHIR-48393 moved profile maintenance out of core; it is already represented on the combined branch.

evidence_items.summary: Published/Persuasive STU3 issue requesting a ShareablePlanDefinition profile requiring url, version, name, title, experimental, description, date, and publisher.
evidence_items.learned: This establishes the final seed request and expected metadata constraints.

evidence_items.summary: Historical GF#18230 commit added plandefinition-shareable-spreadsheet.xml and updated the PlanDefinition spreadsheet.
evidence_items.learned: The seed request was applied in core before later migration/removal work.

evidence_items.summary: R5 history contains ShareablePlanDefinition metadata at the historical core canonical.
evidence_items.learned: The profile persisted into later release history rather than being immediately lost after the STU3 application.

evidence_items.summary: Applied/Persuasive R6 issue instructing removal of ShareablePlanDefinition and related profiles from the base specification because they had already moved to CRMI.
evidence_items.learned: This later final decision makes restoring the core profile incorrect.

evidence_items.summary: FHIR-48393 implementation commit removed the active PlanDefinition shareable/publishable profile files, including structuredefinition-profile-shareableplandefinition.xml.
evidence_items.learned: The current source absence is intentional R6 application, not a missing FHIR-18230 fix.

evidence_items.summary: Current core source directs Shareable/Publishable profile users to CRMI and retains only the historical shareableplandefinition OID in active source.
evidence_items.learned: Core now provides pattern guidance and identifier history but no active ShareablePlanDefinition profile to edit.

evidence_items.summary: Published CRMI exposes CRMI Shareable PlanDefinition at http://hl7.org/fhir/uv/crmi/StructureDefinition/crmi-shareableplandefinition.
evidence_items.learned: Ongoing ShareablePlanDefinition profile maintenance belongs outside the core checkout.

evidence_items.summary: CDS agenda discussion of FHIR-48393 records that TSC determined resource profiles should not be in the base FHIR specification.
evidence_items.learned: The profile removal is supported by governance context, not just a source cleanup.
